source: Iced-Cream's own tests on their unit: the C3A4 and C3N4 builds of the core-ar2 0.3 unit test, recorded in rytm2_mods velocity-humanise/README.md at afd461d; and the SXH4 bench runs on the same unit (2026-10-24 and 2026-10-25); and the solo bench run of VHH4 on the same unit (2026-10-25)
statement: Hardware, OS 1.74, 2026-10-20: in C3A4 (core-ar2 0.3 and all eleven rytm2_mods v1.2 ports) velocity-humanise 1.1's test steps 1 to 3 pass: on the TRIG page FUNC + VEL reads RND with a 0..64 popup; with N = 32 a track of equal-velocity trigs varies in level, with N = 0 it does not; N is kept through save, power-cycle and reload, and through a power-cycle without SAVE PROJECT. In C3N4 (C3A4 without euclid-accents) step 4 passes: steps 1 to 3 behave the same, and euclid on/off is unaffected by N. On SXH4 (released core-ar2 0.3 with the other five Modwerk 1.74 submissions, 2026-10-24/25) N 10 measurably varied CP's equal-velocity hits where N 0 did not, and N was kept through a power cycle without SAVE PROJECT. Alone on VHH4 (released core-ar2 0.3 and this module only, 2026-10-25) N 64 spread CP's equal-velocity hits by about 3 dB where N 0 did not.
scope: velocity-humanise 1.1 beside other rytm2_mods ports (with and without euclid-accents). SXH4 ran it with the released core-ar2 0.3 and the other five Modwerk 1.74 submissions. VHH4 ran it alone with the released core-ar2 0.3.

builds.label: VHH4
builds.content: The released core-ar2 0.3 and this module's rytm2_mods v1.2 release object as the only module, plus the remote-control test layer (analoghealth 1.2, no site shared with core or the module). Driven over USB by a scripted bench in a ~T test project; outputs recorded over USB audio; stock 1.74 restored after the run.
results: Alone: N 64 spreads CP's hits by 2.99 dB per step against 0.36 dB at N 0 (measured).
No freeze or dropout on any output.

builds.label: SXH4
builds.content: The released core-ar2 0.3 and rytm2_mods v1.2's release objects for the six Modwerk 1.74 submissions, plus a remote-control test layer (three sites, none shared with core or the modules). Without the test layer the same inputs give SX74 (2a352718de044cdba51a2b8a3a064ef126d79ab54f24ac7a7662f6c686e64371). Driven over USB by a scripted bench in a ~T test project; outputs recorded over USB audio; stock 1.74 restored after each run.
results: SXH4: N 10 spreads CP's hits by 0.63 dB per step against 0.35 dB at N 0 (measured).
SXH4: N kept through a power cycle without SAVE PROJECT (dial position).

Four minutes of play with samples, delay and reverb sends and knob turns: no freeze, gap or level dip on any output; clicks on the main mix also appear on the same core and test layer without the modules.

builds.label: C3A4
builds.content: core-ar2 0.3 as built before elekloader #153, and rytm2_mods v1.2's eleven OS 1.74 release objects. Relinking those files on stock 1.74 gives this main OS byte for byte.
results: N is kept through a power-cycle without SAVE PROJECT.

builds.label: C3N4
builds.content: C3A4 without euclid-accents: core-ar2 0.3 as built before elekloader #153 and ten of rytm2_mods v1.2's OS 1.74 release objects, this module's included.
results: Step 4: steps 1 to 3 behave the same without euclid-accents, and euclid on/off is unaffected by N.

individualTestResults: N = 32 varies the hits; N = 0 does not
N kept through save, power-cycle and reload
Same without euclid-accents; euclid unaffected by N
SXH4: N 10 varies hits, N 0 does not (measured)
SXH4: N kept through a power cycle without SAVE PROJECT
SXH4: four-minute play, no freeze or dropout
Alone (VHH4): N 64 varies hits, N 0 does not (measured)
